name: Satosho (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Satosho town emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter V.
history: Municipal flag of Satosho, a town in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1968.

features.role: Satosho town emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter V
